title: Phones and narrow windows — round 7, top bar alignment

steps.surface: Top bar in a narrow computer window
steps.path: The YouCoded window on a computer, dragged narrow
steps.headline: Narrow computer window, realigned: the name sits on the buttons' line, the lights centred under it, a gap before terminal.
steps.changed: Your note on round 6: "that looks super jank. the alignment is all fucked up". Three things were off: the lights started left of the name's dot, the name sat higher than every button beside it, and its arrow touched the terminal button. All three are fixed.
steps.notice: ☰, the name, the terminal switch and the window buttons now share one centre line. Projects is still in ☰ here, and the 340-pixel window minimum stays.

steps.path: The strip across the top of the Android app
steps.headline: The phone bar gets the same fix: the name now lines up with ☰, Projects and terminal, the lights just under it.
steps.changed: Same change as the narrow window, since the phone used the same name-and-lights stack. Before, the lights pushed the name a few pixels above the buttons.
steps.notice: Nothing else on the phone bar changed since you approved it in round 5.
